topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture's learning objectives, the stepwise model of tumor progression, and the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in signaling cascades, such as Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinases, Ras-MAPK, and PI3K-AKT, sustain proliferative signaling and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells fail to withdraw from the cell cycle and differentiate into functional mature cell types across leukemias and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis, replicative immortality, and p53 stress control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells overcome intrinsic growth-limiting barriers through p53 pathway inactivation, resistance to apoptosis, and telomerase reactivation, summarizing the primary growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the metabolic alterations in cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis (the Warburg effect), cancer-type metabolic profiles, and driver mutations in metabolic enzymes.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the angiogenic switch and the mechanisms by which tumors induce new blood vessel formation to overcome hypoxia and support growth.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and the biology of metastases
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the sequential steps of metastasis, the seed and soil hypothesis, clinical monitoring of circulating tumor cells, and genomic findings from metastatic lesions.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing thoughts on cancer hallmarks, suggestions for further reading, and housekeeping for upcoming practical sessions.
